Plot 14,220.38 sq m · basement + ground + mezzanine + 5 parking floors + 19 and 24 residential floors + mechanical floors + roof · 1,204 homes (864 studios, 140 one-bedroom, 140 two-bedroom, 60 three-bedroom) and 28 shops

Plot 14,325.92 sq m · basement + ground + mezzanine + 5 parking floors + 30 and 34 residential floors + 2 mechanical floors + roof · 1,844 homes (1,344 studios, 220 one-bedroom, 220 two-bedroom, 60 three-bedroom) and 34 shops
